name: herdr
description: Teaches an agent to use Herdr, the terminal workspace manager for coding agents: start worktrees and agents, prompt them safely, listen to their work and see what is running. Standalone and thin over the herdr CLI; no workflow of its own.

interface.shortDescription: Start, prompt and listen to agents in Herdr worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Herdr skills for coding agents running inside Herdr: start a worktree with agents on it, start an agent in a pane, send prompts without duplicates, listen to agents and surface the questions they are blocked on, and see which agents and worktrees are running. Requires the herdr CLI, bash, jq and a Herdr-managed pane.
defaultPrompt: Start a Herdr worktree with an agent on it.
Listen to the agents in this worktree.
Which agents are running in Herdr?
